scope: production identity/album/ref repositories and SQLite with verified-context input fixture; not actual network/desktop or fingerprint truth proof
cases: narrow identity readers reject values, source IDs, duplicate mappings/targets, unknown kinds and unconfirmed types
separate recording/release targets show all global recording members and canonical recording title
partial mapping and unreviewed extra tracks block release identity but permit individual recordings
public preview changes do not authorize foreign or blocked target keys
separate scope acknowledgements are mandatory before any identity write
a later SQLite failure rolls back every reference, audit and aggregate receipt
atomic recording plus release confirmation preserves local identities, text, favorites/playlists and immutable source facts
receipt-first retry survives cancellation/restart/offline and command mismatch is rejected
source-retention identity counts and paged history include all confirmations
